decisions.rationale: ROOT confirmed both failures are localized synthetic-fixture drift with no production or pinned-server defect: the bare C3 topology omits its required signing public key, and the diagnostic controller/result identity uses physical lane STM-A where the exact worker completion contract requires F.C3.A1. Two small test-only identity corrections restore the intended acceptance evidence without weakening fail-closed production checks. Their value exceeds their minimal complexity and regression risk.
decisions.smallest_fix: Add the required public_key to the bare C3 topology and consistently bind the synthetic diagnostic invocation/status/result lane identity to F.C3.A1 while retaining STM-A only in the physical lane fields; rerun only the two errored IDs.
